project-engine-layer-enforcement.name: enforce at the engine seam
project-engine-layer-enforcement.template: Move {subject}'s enforcement from the interface surface to the shared engine seam (the *_core write path), so CLI, MCP, and library ingress all inherit the same invariant; keep interface layers to parsing and presentation.

project-portability.name: restore rebar portability
project-portability.template: Rework {subject} so it remains portable across supported rebar client shapes; keep project-specific behavior in project configuration or an explicit extension boundary.

project-symbol-reference-completeness.name: re-derive the reference inventory with Serena
project-symbol-reference-completeness.template: Re-derive {subject}'s affected-file/call-site inventory with Serena's find_referencing_symbols instead of hand enumeration, and grep the codebase for each renamed/removed symbol's name as a string (e.g. in monkeypatch.setattr, getattr, or importlib calls) to catch references the LSP cannot resolve.
